#create Seurat object
```{r}

#load the RNA data in Seurat v5
dir <- paste0(getwd(),"/scratch/matrixes")
sample_ids <- c(
  "LONZApre","WTpre","LONZApost","WTmyod4",
  "OPTIOXd4","GERALTd4","OPTIOXd7","GERALTd7"
)

# create a Seurat object containing the RNA data
objs <- lapply(sample_ids, function(sample_id) {

  counts <- ReadMtx(
    mtx      = file.path(dir, paste0(sample_id, ".scRNA.filtered.matrix.mtx.gz")),
    features = file.path(dir, paste0(sample_id, ".scRNA.filtered.features.tsv.gz")),
    cells    = file.path(dir, paste0(sample_id, ".scRNA.filtered.barcodes.tsv.gz")),
    feature.column = 2
  )
# keep only protein-coding genes
  counts <- counts[rownames(counts) %in% protein_coding_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = sample_id, assay = "RNA")
  obj$sample <- sample_id
  obj
})

names(objs) <- sample_ids
objs <- objs[sample_ids]

###select based on valid cells
objs[["GERALTd4"]]=subset(objs[["GERALTd4"]], cells=valid_cell_ids)

data_seurat <- merge(
  x = objs[[1]],
  y = objs[-1],
  add.cell.ids = sample_ids,
  project = "AB015"
)

```

#QC library
```{r}
#-----------------------------
# 1. SET QC thresholds
#-----------------------------

# thresholds for exploratory plots
mito_set1 <- 0
mito_set2 <- 15
ribo_set  <- 1
nGene1    <- 100
nGene2    <- 7000
nUMIset   <- 100

# grouping variable used in AB015
sample_var <- "sample"

# palette used in AB015
qc_pal <- pal


#-----------------------------
# 2. Calculate QC metrics
#-----------------------------

DefaultAssay(data_seurat) <- "RNA"

data_seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  data_seurat,
  pattern = "^MT-"
)

data_seurat[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  data_seurat,
  pattern = "RPS"
)

QC <- data_seurat[[c(
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mt",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "percent.ribo",
  sample_var
)]]

QC <- QC %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    nUMI  = nCount_RNA,
    nGene = nFeature_RNA
  )

QC$info <- rownames(QC)
QC$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(QC$nGene) / log10(QC$nUMI)


#-----------------------------
# 3. QC exploratory plots
#-----------------------------

plot1 <- ggplot(QC, aes(x = .data[[sample_var]], y = nGene, fill = .data[[sample_var]])) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = qc_pal) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = nGene1, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = nGene2, linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = sample_var, y = "nGene")

print(plot1)

plot2 <- ggplot(QC, aes(x = .data[[sample_var]], y = nUMI, fill = .data[[sample_var]])) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = qc_pal) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = nUMIset, linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = sample_var, y = "nUMI")

print(plot2)

plot1 + plot2

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(fname_prefix_ribomito_QC, "_feature_QC_old.pdf"),
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
```

###do QC cuts

```{r}
#-----------------------------
# 4. Apply QC filters
#-----------------------------
# Final thresholds for filtering
mito_set2 <- 15
nGene1    <- 100
nGene2    <- 7000
nUMIset   <- 100

filtered_seurat <- subset(
  data_seurat,
  subset =
    nFeature_RNA > nGene1 &
    nFeature_RNA < nGene2 &
    nCount_RNA > nUMIset &
    percent.mt < mito_set2
)

metadata <- filtered_seurat[[]]

# Join RNA layers for Seurat v5 compatibility before extracting counts
filtered_seurat <- JoinLayers(filtered_seurat, assay = "RNA")

counts <- GetAssayData(
  filtered_seurat,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)

write.csv(
  counts,
  paste0(fname_prefix_csv_QC, "_silencing_matrix_all_samples_AB015.csv")
)

write.csv(
  metadata,
  paste0(fname_prefix_csv_QC, "_cell_metadata_filtered_AB015.csv")
)

#-----------------------------
# 5. QC counts summary
#-----------------------------

post_QCcounts <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data[[sample_var]]) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Post_QC = n(), .groups = "drop")

post_QCcounts$tr_nGene <- paste0(
  "more than ", nGene1,
  " genes per cell and less than ", nGene2)
post_QCcounts$tr_n_count_UMI <- paste0(
  "more than ", nUMIset, " UMI")
post_QCcounts$tr_mito <- paste0(
  "less than ", mito_set2, "%")
post_QCcounts$tr_ribo <- "not applied"

pre_QCcounts <- pre_QCcounts %>%
  dplyr::rename(Pre_QC = count)

QCcounts <- post_QCcounts %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pre_QCcounts, by = sample_var) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lost = Pre_QC - Post_QC) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(Pre_QC, Post_QC, lost, .after = all_of(sample_var))

write.csv(
  post_QCcounts,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_QC, "_post_QCcounts.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  QCcounts,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_QC, "_QCcounts.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)

#-----------------------------
# 6. Save filtered object
#-----------------------------

Rdata_filename <- paste0(fname_prefix_R_QC, "_seurat_data_filtered.RData")

save(
  meta_original,
  counts,
  metadata,
  filtered_seurat,
  file = Rdata_filename
)

#-----------------------------
# 7. QC plots after filtering
#-----------------------------

  filtered_seurat,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = sample_var
) +

plot3 <- FeatureScatter(
```

#add prepare data for Monocle

```{r}
post_QCcounts=post_QCcounts%>%mutate(cell_type=c("GERALT","GERALT","LONZA","LONZA","OPTIOX","OPTIOX","WT","WT"),
                                     timepoint=c("D4","D7","post fusion","pre fusion","D4","D7","D4","pre fusion"))
metadata=metadata%>%left_join(post_QCcounts,by=c("sample"))
rownames(metadata)=metadata$libID
####gather info from Seurat
cell_metadata=metadata
expression_matrix <- filtered_seurat@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]]
counts <- GetAssayData(object = filtered_seurat, slot = "counts")

# get gene annotations
gene_annotation=data.frame(rownames(counts))
colnames(gene_annotation) <- "gene_short_name"
rownames(gene_annotation)=gene_annotation$gene_short_name

```

```{r}
#set.seed(79876858)
```

###get top genes in a loop 

```{r}
marker_test_res = top_markers(cds, group_cells_by="monocle_clusters", reference_cells=NULL, cores=16)
marker_test_res <- top_markers(cds, group_cells_by="monocle_clusters", 
                               reference_cells=10000, cores=8)

# List of top_n values to iterate through
top_n_values <- c(2, 5, 10, 25)

# Loop through each top_n value
for (n in top_n_values) {
  
  # Filter markers and select the top_n genes
  top_specific_markers <- marker_test_res %>%
    filter(fraction_expressing >= 0.10) %>%
    group_by(cell_group) %>%
    top_n(n, pseudo_R2)
  
  # Extract unique gene IDs
  top_specific_marker_ids <- unique(top_specific_markers %>% dplyr::pull(gene_id))
  
  # Create a data frame for the top genes
  t_data <- data.frame(
    ids = top_specific_markers$gene_id, 
    cluster = top_specific_markers$cell_group, 
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Write the data to a CSV file
  write.csv(
    t_data, 
    file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_", "top_", n, "genes_per_cluster.csv"), 
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Generate a heatmap plot
  p <- plot_genes_by_group(
    cds,
    top_specific_marker_ids,
    group_cells_by = "monocle_clusters",
    ordering_type = "maximal_on_diag",
    max.size = 3
  ) + scale_color_viridis(option = "E", discrete = FALSE)
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_heatmap, "_", "top", n, "_heatmap.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 8, 
    height = ifelse(n == 5, 10, 25) # Adjust the height for larger plots
  )
}

```

```{r}
                  "RAD51","CHEK1","ORC6","MCM3","MCM7","MLF1IP","BRIP1","E2F8"),
  # Ref: Seurat S.Score; Whitfield et al., Cell 2002; Trapnell et al., Nat Biotech 2014

  cellcycle_g2m = c("HMGB2","CDK1","NUSAP1","UBE2C","BIRC5","TPX2","TOP2A","NDC80",
                    "CKS2","NUF2","CKS1B","MKI67","TMPO","CENPF","TACC3","SMC4",
                    "CCNB2","CKAP2L","CKAP2","AURKB","BUB1","KIF11","ANP32E","TUBB4B",
                    "GTSE1","KIF20B","HJURP","CDCA3","CDC20","TTK","CDC45","CDC6",
                    "EXO1","TIPIN","DSCC1","BLM","CASP8AP2","USP1","CLSPN","POLA1",
                    "CHAF1B","BRCA1","EXOSC2","USP16","POLD3","MSH2","ATAD2","RAD51AP1","RRM2"),
  # Ref: Seurat G2M.Score; Whitfield et al., Cell 2002; Trapnell 2014
  
  ribosome_tone = c("RPLP0","RPL3","RPL5","RPL7","RPL11","RPL13A","RPL23A",
                    "RPS3","RPS6","RPS8","RPS12","RPS18","RPS27","NCL","FBL",
                    "NPM1","EIF4EBP1","MYC","DDIT4"),
  # Ref: Murgia et al. 2021; Chemello et al. 2025 (fiber proteome core)

  # ===============================
  # FIBER-TYPE / METABOLIC PROGRAMS
  # ===============================
  fiber_type_I_slow = c("MYH7","TNNI1","TNNT1","MYL2","ATP2A2","CKMT2","MB",
                        "COX7A1","COX6A2","PPARGC1A","SDHA","CS","SLC25A4",
                        "MYBPC1","MYL3","PDK4","ESRRA","NDUFA10"),
  # Ref: Schiaffino & Reggiani 2011; Chemello et al. 2025; Murgia et al. 2021

  fiber_type_IIa_fast = c("MYH2","TNNI2","TNNT3","MYL1","ATP2A1","ACTN3","TPM2",
                          "PVALB","LDHA","PKM","PFKM","ENO1","PGAM2","ALDOA",
                          "CKM","DMD","CASQ1"),
  # Ref: Murgia et al. 2021; Bloemberg & Quadrilatero 2012; Chemello 2025

  fiber_type_IIx_fast = c("MYH1","ACTN3","MYLK2","TNNT3","TNNI2","ATP2A1","TPM2",
                          "CKM","LDHA","ENO1","PFKM","MYH4"),
  # Ref: Murgia 2021; Uhlén et al., HPA 2021

developmental_embryonic = c("MYH3", "MYH8", "MYL4", "TNNI1", "TNNT1",
                             "CHRNG", "NEFM", "NES", "CCND2"),
# Solo geni veramente embrionali/fetali
# Rimossi MYOG, MYOD1, MEF2C, DES, CKM, MYMK, MYMX, ACTA1
# Ref: Chal et al. 2015; Hicks et al. 2025; Sampath et al. 2018
# and immature contractile/NMJ-associated genes.
# Ref: Schiaffino et al. 2015 Skeletal Muscle; Chal et al. 2015 Nat Biotechnol;
# Xi et al. 2020 Cell Stem Cell human skeletal muscle atlas.

myotube_fusion_active = c("MYOG", "MYMK", "MYMX", "MEF2C", "DNM2",
                           "ACTA1", "CKM", "DES"),
# Geni del processo di fusione attivo — specifica per la transizione cl8→cl9
# Active myoblast-to-myotube fusion / early terminal differentiation program.
# MYMK and MYMX/Myomerger are core fusogens; MYOG/MEF2C drive terminal
# myogenic differentiation; DNM2 supports membrane-remodeling processes.
# Ref: Millay et al. 2013 Nature; Leikina et al. 2018 Dev Cell;
# Luo et al. 2020 Cell Mol Life Sci; Carvajal/Vicente-Garcia 2022/MEF2C refs.

  sarcomere_core = c("TTN","NEB","ACTN2","TCAP","MYBPC1","MYBPC2","MYL1","MYL2",
                     "TNNI1","TNNI2","TNNT1","TNNT3","TPM1","TPM2","MYOM1","MYOM2","CSRP3","ANKRD1", "FHL1", "MYBPH"),
# Sarcomere/myofibril structural program, extended to include nascent
# sarcomere-associated mechanosensing/remodeling genes enriched in cl9.
# Ref: GO:0030017 sarcomere / GO:0030016 myofibril;
# ANKRD1 MARP/mechanosensing reviews; FHL1 skeletal muscle sarcomere formation.
# Ref: Lundberg et al. 2019; GO:0030016 "myofibril"

# 2. signature per miotubi post-fusione nascenti (cl9)
nascent_myotube_postfusion = c("ANKRD1", "MYBPH", "FHL1", "CDKN1A",
                                "TNNT2", "TNNT3", "BIN1", "COX6A2",
                                "CRYAB", "F13A1", "PTGDS", "SIRT2"),
# Dataset-driven cl9 early post-fusion myotube signature.
# Captures nascent sarcomere/mechanosensing (ANKRD1, FHL1, MYBPH),
# early contractile remodeling (TNNT2/TNNT3), membrane/T-tubule maturation
# (BIN1), cell-cycle exit (CDKN1A), and early metabolic/stress adaptation
# (COX6A2, CRYAB, SIRT2).
# F13A1/PTGDS are retained as top cl9 DEG markers from this dataset and
# should be interpreted as empirical cl9 markers rather than canonical myotube genes.
# Ref: ANKRD1 reviews; Cowling/FHL1 JCB 2008; BIN1 sarcomere/T-tubule papers;
# Halevy et al. 1995 p21/MyoD terminal differentiation.

calcium_excitation_contraction = c("RYR1","CACNA1S","ATP2A1","ATP2A2","CASQ1",
                                     "CASQ2","SLN","PLN","TRDN","STAC3","JPH1",
                                     "CAMK2A","CAMK2B","CAV3"),
  # Ref: Protasi et al. 2021; Jorgensen et al. 2023 (hiPSC EC coupling)

  oxidative_mitochondrial = c("SDHA","SDHB","UQCRC1","NDUFA9","NDUFS1","COX4I1",
                              "COX6A2","ATP5F1A","ATP5MC1","CKMT2","SLC25A4",
                              "PPARGC1A","TFAM","CS","ACADM","NDUFB8","CYCS","PDHA1"),
  # Ref: Lin et al. Nature 2002; Chemello et al. 2025; Murgia 2021

  glycolytic_fast = c("HK2","PFKM","ALDOA","TPI1","GAPDH","PGK1","PGAM2","ENO1",
                      "PKM","LDHA","PDK1","SLC2A4","PFKFB3","ENO3","MYL1"),
  # Ref: Schiaffino & Reggiani 2011; Chemello 2025

  # ===============================
  # STEM / MYOGENIC LINEAGES
  # ===============================
satellite_cell_core = c("PAX7","VCAM1","ITGA7","CXCR4","MYF5","CDH15","SDC4",
                          "EGFR","NCAM1","SPRY1","MUSTN1","NOS1"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020; Yin et al. 2013; GSE143437 atlas
  satellite_cell_core_hiPSC = c("ITGA7","MYF5","CDH15","NCAM1","SPRY1"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020; Yin et al. 2013; GSE143437 atlas

  myoblast_proliferation_cycle = c("MYOD1","MYF5","MKI67","TOP2A","PCNA","CCNB1",
                                   "CDK1","E2F1","NUSAP1","HMGB2","UBE2C","AURKB","RRM2"),
  # Ref: Hicks et al. 2025; Trapnell et al. 2014 pseudotime

  myotube_differentiation_fusion = c("MYOG","MEF2C","MYMK","MYMX","MYH3","MYH8",
                                     "CKM","DES","DNM2","ACTA1"), #similar to the previous (consider that)
  # Ref: Chal et al. 2015; Sampath et al. 2018; Hicks 2025

  myogenic_regulators_axis = c("PAX3","PAX7","MYF5","MYOD1","MYOG","MEF2C","MYF6"),
  # Ref: Weintraub 1991; Rudnicki et al. 1993

  # ===============================
  # NMJ / ECM / NICHE
  # ===============================
  neuromuscular_junction = c("AGRN","LRP4","MUSK","DOK7","RAPSN","COLQ","CHRNA1",
                             "CHRNB1","CHRND","CHRNE","CHRNG","ACHE","UTRN"),
  # Ref: Burden et al. 2018; Cantor et al. 2022 (hiPSC NMJ coculture)

  muscle_ecm_basement = c("LAMA2","LAMC1","COL6A1","COL6A2","COL6A3","COL1A1",
                          "COL1A2","COL3A1","FN1","SPP1","LUM","DCN","DAG1",
                          "ITGA7","THY1","COL4A1","COL4A2","COL5A1"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020; Saini et al. 2021

  fibro_adipogenic_progenitors = c("PDGFRA","COL1A1","COL3A1","DCN","LUM","CXCL14",
                                   "THY1","GPC6","FBN1","DPT","POSTN","PCOLCE"),
  # Ref: De Micheli 2020; Front Cell Dev Biol 2025

  atrophy_stress = c("FBXO32","TRIM63","DDIT4","GADD45A","ATF4","FOXO3","PSMA1",
                     "PSMB1","SESN1","SESN3","EIF4EBP1","PPP1R15A"),
  # Ref: Bodine et al. 2001; Gomes et al. 2001; Milan et al. 2021

  # ===============================

  pluripotency_core = c("POU5F1","NANOG","SOX2","PRDM14","DPPA2","DPPA4","ZFP42",
                        "DNMT3A","DNMT3B"),

  naive_pluripotency = c("KLF17","KLF4","TFCP2L1","DNMT3L","DPPA3","TBX3","ESRRB","SUSD2"),

  early_myogenic_commitment = c("PAX3","PAX7","MYF5","MYOD1","MET","ITGA7","FGFR4","LBX1","MYOG"),

hiPSC_to_mesoderm_transition= c("TBXT", "MESP1", "MIXL1", "GSC", "EOMES"),
oxidative_stress_antioxidant=c("NQO1", "HMOX1", "TXNIP", "FTH1", "MT1E", "MT2A", "SLC7A11", "SRXN1")
)
```

###add features
```{r}
fix_features <- function(object, genes) {
  present <- intersect(genes, rownames(object))
  if (length(present) == 0L) warning("No genes found from set: ", paste(head(genes, 5), collapse=", "))
  present
}

# Compute module scores for every set in `gs`
for (nm in names(gs)) {
  feats <- fix_features(seurat_AB015, gs[[nm]])
  # skip empty sets
  if (length(feats) == 0L) next
  seurat_AB015 <- AddModuleScore(
    object   = seurat_AB015,
    features = list(feats),        # one set at a time
    nbin = 20,                    # default is 24; adjust if needed
    name     = paste0(nm, "_score")# Seurat will append "1"
  )
  # Move the created column <name>1 into a clean column <name>
  raw_col <- paste0(nm, "_score1")
  if (raw_col %in% colnames(seurat_AB015@meta.data)) {
    seurat_AB015@meta.data[[nm]] <- seurat_AB015@meta.data[[raw_col]]
    # optional: drop the generated column
    seurat_AB015@meta.data[[raw_col]] <- NULL
  }
}

common_cells <- intersect(colnames(seurat_AB015), colnames(cds))
if (length(common_cells) == 0L) stop("No overlapping cells between Seurat and cds.")

for (nm in names(gs)) {
  if (nm %in% colnames(seurat_AB015@meta.data)) {
    vec <- seurat_AB015@meta.data[common_cells, nm, drop=TRUE]
    colData(cds)[common_cells, nm] <- vec
  }
}

feat_to_plot <- c(names(gs))

for (feat in feat_to_plot) {
  if (!feat %in% colnames(colData(cds))) next
  p <- plot_cells(
    cds,
    reduction_method   = "UMAP",
    color_cells_by     = feat,
    label_cell_groups  = TRUE,
    show_trajectory_graph = FALSE
  ) +
    labs(title = feat, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_c(option = "E")
  ggsave(paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_UMAP_sign_", feat, ".pdf"), p, width = 4, height = 3)
}

meta=as.data.frame(cds@colData@listData)
```
